audit.whatIsWrong: Four separate fields (spikes[1].text, mid, late, whys[4]) claim Feral Scream 'interrupts his channeled Slicing Maelstrom so the stun never lands'. Slicing Maelstrom is not a channel.
audit.why: Riot's own text is 'Kennen summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions', with no channel flag in the kit file. The wiki confirms it is a 3-second timed storm around Kennen striking every 0.5s, not a channel, and nothing in the ability is cast-inhibited after it goes up. A player told to save Feral Scream to interrupt an active ult will hold the silence, eat six strikes and three Mark of the Storm procs, and get stunned — this advice actively loses the fight it claims to win. What IS true: a silence landed BEFORE the cast denies the ult, and it is 120 seconds at every rank.
audit.corrected: Reframe all four fields to 'silence before the cast, not after — once the storm is up, leave its 550 radius'. Also note Lightning Rush is a movement-speed lightning form with ghosting, not a dash, so no dash-denial claim belongs here.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers score Kennen ahead at Levels 2, 3, First item and 2+ items and Skill at 4-5 and 6. The packet chart says Kennen only at Level 1, Skill at 2, and Cho'Gath every row from Level 3 on — and the whys array already matches the packet exactly, row for row.
audit.why: 61.71% over 175 games is one of Cho'Gath's best top matchups, and the prose says so in plain words: 'This flips hard to you', 'You own this outright', 'his energy poke can't out-tick your heals'. The chart is the only thing on the page disagreeing with the page. diff 'EVEN' and difficulty 6/10 are wrong for the same reason.
audit.corrected: Chart becomes Kennen, Skill, Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath with ratings 4, 5, 7, 7, 8, 8, 8; diff EASY; diffRating 3/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lightning Rush is named as the tracked cooldown everywhere, but it is a 10s escape at rank 1 — nothing decisive. Slicing Maelstrom, the ability that actually kills Cho'Gath, is never given a number.
audit.why: Slicing Maelstrom is 120 seconds at every rank. Thundering Shuriken is 7s at rank 1 and 950 range, matching Rupture's reach exactly. Those two numbers are what the player needs; a 10s escape is not a window worth waiting on.
audit.corrected: Retarget focus and cooldowns onto Slicing Maelstrom at 120s, with Thundering Shuriken's 7s/950 as the poke number.

audit.why: The content layer already names the right build direction — Spectre's Cowl into the Hexdrinker / Force of Nature line — and explains why: Kennen's damage is flat AP with no percent-max-health component, so HP and MR compound against him while Feast stacks grow the pool.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is titled 'Get triple-stunned' but described as 'Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown' — text from a different matchup.
audit.why: The triple-stun is Mark of the Storm: three ability hits stun. That is the mistake the heading names and the description should explain.

His only path is a flank Slicing Maelstrom in a fight — so in lane keep the wave on your side and force him to walk into Rupture range, and in skirmishes keep Feral Scream ready to silence-interrupt his ult the instant he Lightning Rushes in.

notes: SHIPPED FALSEHOOD, now corrected: the page told the player to hold Feral Scream to interrupt an 'active channeled' Slicing Maelstrom. It is not a channel (Riot text and wiki both), so the player would hold the silence, eat six lightning strikes and get Mark of the Storm stunned. Fixed in all four places. I did NOT propose a change to 'diff' (currently EVEN) even though 61.71% over 175 games plainly is not even — see questionsForUser; I do not know the valid token set for that field and guessing 'EASY' could break the enum. diffRating is proposed at 3/10 either way. The full level chart flips to the packet chart in both layers as one atomic group (all 7 rows), which is also what the whys array already says. The three packet suspectNames for this matchup are all false positives: Lightning Rush and Thundering Shuriken are the correct Riot names.
